newsitem.title: NORWAY: Oslo Bourse says trade resuming after problem.
newsitem.headline: Oslo Bourse says trade resuming after problem.

text.p: Trade in shares and bonds was resuming on the Norwegian stock exchange on Tuesday after a two-hour break caused by technical problems, the bourse said in a statement.
"The technical problems have been solved and trade in shares will resume at 12.15 p.m. (1015 GMT)," the statement said.
"Trade in bonds and fixed income derivatives will start at 12.20 p.m. (1020 GMT)," it said.
